name: Mobile first-screen + availability box (Noah Igler)

sources.name: Noah Igler — mobile first screen for home-service LPs
sources.note: HVAC/local SEO pattern: logo+call, real Google rating bar, service+city H1, two reassurances, two sentences, same-day availability box + Book Online. Adapted here as a consult/book first-screen for Peak (and other tenants), not a numbered listicle.

density.length_band: keep the first screen under ~120 words; anything longer goes below the fold

components.hint: Visible Advertisement label (harness requirement) — keep it small so it does not steal the thumb zone
Logo left + one big primary action top-right (call or Book a consult). No full nav — menu icon only if needed.

Real platform rating + count with stars (e.g. Judge.me / Google). Verified numbers only — never invent 12,700-style counts. If reviews_summary is null, omit or use one attributed recent customer line instead.
Service/product + market or use-case as H1 (e.g. 'Infrared Saunas for Home Recovery' / model + city if local). Not a slogan.
Exactly two trust lines the customer cares about most (not six icon noise). Peak defaults: free shipping, warranty — verified only.
Sentence 1: who you are. Sentence 2: what happens when they call/book. Stop there above the fold.

High-contrast box: availability / next step + one big CTA. Source pattern: 'Same-day availability. Next available appointment: 1:00 PM' + Book Online. Peak: do NOT invent appointment times — use consult framing ('Talk to a specialist' / 'Book a consult') or a rule-based window the team can honor. One CTA phrase, reused.
Optional after scroll: proof bullets, specs, trust strip — product-page fields. First screen must stand alone.

two_reassurances.peak_hint: Limited lifetime warranty line — exact fixed sentence or omit

two_sentences.peak_hint: US-owned / family framing only if verified
A specialist helps with sizing, voltage, delivery — no fake 24/7 claims

availability_box.line_1: availability claim the team can honor (no invented CRM slots)
availability_box.line_2_optional: next step without a fake clock time unless wired to real scheduling
availability_box.cta: one allowlisted CTA — prefer consult variants when cta_mode is consult/auto

product_page_field_map.hero.price_line: optional below fold — not required above fold for consult mode
product_page_field_map.proof_bullets: map two_reassurances + one more benefit below fold if needed (schema wants 3)
product_page_field_map.cta_text: availability_box CTA — Book a consult / Shop the {model}

cta.note: Source uses Call + Book Online. Harness one-CTA rule: pick one phrase (consult or buy) and reuse it; header may be tel: link with same label only if tenant allows — otherwise both buttons use the same cta_text/url.

notes: Never invent review counts, star ratings, or 'next available' appointment times.
Availability copy must be a rule the business can honor, or soft consult language with no clock time.
Licensed/insured/24/7 claims only if in verified_claims — Peak should not copy HVAC trust lines verbatim.
Advertisement label still required on harness pages.

first_screen_fill.headline: Infrared Saunas for Home Recovery — or '{Model} Infrared Sauna'
first_screen_fill.who: Peak Saunas — home infrared with red light included standard (verified framing only)
first_screen_fill.what_happens: Book a consult and a specialist helps with model, outlet, and delivery.
first_screen_fill.availability_box: Consultations available — Book a consult (no fake 1:00 PM slot unless scheduling is wired)

image_role_map.hero: product hero above or behind first screen if space allows — pattern is copy-led on mobile

writer_brief: Build the ABOVE-THE-FOLD first screen only from this map: header action, real rating bar, service/product+market H1, exactly two reassurances, exactly two sentences, then an availability/consult box with one big CTA. Map into product-page schema fields (see product_page_field_map). Do not invent appointment times or review counts. Prefer consult CTA phrasing. Keep density extremely short — this skeleton wins by fitting on one phone screen before scroll.
